stories.title: Dog exercise park facilty rejected by Flintshire planners
stories.summary: Plans to open a dog exercise facility in Penymynydd have been turned down by Flintshire County Council’s Planning Committee. stories.title: Oakenholt housing plan branded a ‘ghetto’ approved after developer scales back homes
stories.summary: An affordable housing development in Flint once branded a ‘ghetto’ over plans to densely pack homes in has been approved after the number of properties was reduced. stories.title: More must be done to protect Welsh rivers from drought, says charity
stories.summary: Wales must do more to protect its rivers from drought, according to Afonydd Cymru, the charity representing the country’s six regional rivers trusts. stories.title: Natural Resources Wales raises alert as rivers and wildlife feel the strain
stories.summary: Parts of north and south east Wales have moved to prolonged dry weather status, Natural Resources Wales confirmed on Wednesday. stories.title: Ken Skates says ALN funding dispute forced Labour to reject budget
stories.summary: New Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates said he regretted that his party could not support the Welsh Government’s supplementary budget that reallocated £344 million of ALN funding elsewhere.
